jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Salesforce Developer to join our vibrant technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized Salesforce solutions that enhance our customer relationship management capabilities. Your expertise will drive seamless integration with various platforms and ensure our Salesforce environment operates efficiently and securely. This is an exciting opportunity to leverage your technical skills to deliver impactful solutions that support our business growth and improve user experience.

**Duties**

* Develop, customize, and optimize Salesforce applications using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and other Salesforce tools to meet business requirements.
* Integrate Salesforce with external systems through APIs, REST services, and other middleware solutions to ensure data consistency and real-time updates.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver scalable solutions.
* Maintain version control using SVN or GitHub, ensuring code quality and proper documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning of Salesforce applications to maximize efficiency.
* Support deployment processes by managing release cycles, conducting testing, and ensuring smooth transitions between environments.
* Stay current with Salesforce platform updates and industry best practices to continually improve system functionality.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in software development with a strong focus on application development within the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, C#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C++, C, VBA, and.NET frameworks.
* Hands-on experience working with APIs (RESTful services), SQL databases (MySQL, MS SQL), and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
* Familiarity with version control systems including GitHub and SVN for managing code repositories.
* Knowledge of front-end development techniques including Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Visualforce pages.
* Experience working on Linux environments and utilizing tools like Git for collaboration.
* Strong understanding of software development best practices including Agile methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex issues quickly and effectively.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate across teams and translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Join us as a Salesforce Developer to be at the forefront of innovative technology solutions! Your expertise will help shape our digital future while providing enriching opportunities for professional growth in a fast-paced environment committed to excellence.

Pay: Up to £70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Test Software Developer
jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented engineering professional to join our Test R&D Software Solution team within the Global Technology R&D organization. You will be responsible for developing automation and robotics solutions, overseeing the development of all software applications. You will work in an international, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment, interacting with factories, IT, product groups, quality, finance, suppliers, and executive management.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

You will be contributing to implementing ST's vision and roadmap towards Industry 4.0 with below key responsibilities:

* Analyzing processes to automate them using standard technology bricks
* Developing prototypes and software solutions internally or through external suppliers
* Conducting technical and economic benchmarks between different software solutions
* Building and coordinating software development projects, evaluating their costs, benefits, risks, and issues
* Reporting the project status to executive managers
  

**YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES**

* Master's degree in computer engineering, electronic engineering, computer science
* Excellent knowledge of the English language, both written and spoken
* Knowledge of C#, C++ languages and solid foundations in object-oriented programming
* Knowledge of Java
* Knowledge of Python
* Knowledge of Git and versioning in general
* Knowledge of databases and SQL, SQLite languages
* Knowledge of XML and XSD formats
* 1-2 years' experience in the industrial automation sector, preferably in the semiconductor sector

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

  
  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

📍 Location: JBT Marel Lichtenvoorde

🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time, Hybrid (3-4 days a week at the office)

💼 Department: MEAT – Primary EMEA

💥 Lead the Future of Work at JBT Marel

If you like to do what you love, you’ll enjoy being a part of our software team at JBT Marel.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to join our Engineering team working on innovative software products for the Food Industry. In the role of a Senior Software Engineer, you will have a key role in the development of our software that supports JBT Marel‘s vision of transforming the way food is processed globally.

Within our team we encourage everyone to come forward with interesting ideas and challenge our way of thinking, so we can make the good things happen. If you’re interested in best practices and learning new technics/tools – JBT Marel is the place to be.

🔍 About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of software modules that support JBT-Marel’s vision. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including machine engineering and software platform development teams, to deliver robust and scalable solutions for industrial food processing machines.

🧠 What You’ll Do

Lead design, implementation, and testing of innovative software modules and features.
Optimize existing software solutions and design next gen software solutions for the food processing industry
Analyze requirements and write design specifications for software modules and software features
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team collaboration.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to ensure system architecture is implemented and tested.
Occasionally support product releases and training on customer sites.
Train and mentor Software Engineers and Associate Software Engineers
Contribute to team collaboration and build team spirit
Work in an Agile Scrum environment focused on collaboration, speed, and customer value

🛠️ What You Bring

We encourage each of our 12,000+ employees to bring their unique self to work and aim to make everyone feel recognized, valued and free to explore their potential. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture and welcome new colleagues from all walks of life. You will recognize in yourself that you:

Bachelor’s or Master‘s degree in computer science or similar, or comparable work experience and knowledge
Experience with .NET and Docker.
Experience with Azure DevOps and Git.
Experience in designing, developing, and implementing large software solutions with object-oriented programming languages, in combination with .NET software development.
Strong knowledge of SQL and good understanding of database operations
Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of co-workers, stakeholders, and customers.
Fluent in English (written and verbal).
Willingness to travel occasionally.

🌟
Nice to Have

Background in industrial automation or machine control.
Understanding of reliability requirements in the food industry.
Experience with and comfort working in multi-cultural, multi-discipline organization is an advantage.
Familiar with Agile software development frameworks and database operations
Basic knowledge of Linux and familiarity with PLCs.

🏬 Why Join Us?

There’s Nothing Like The Feeling You Get When You Do Something Worthwhile For a Living. That Said, Coming Home From Work Knowing You Made a Difference Is Just One Of The Great Things You Can Experience At JBT Marel. You Can Expect

Freedom to form your role and define your added value to the organization
Freedom to take initiative and make a real impact in a growing global business
An environment of trust and respect with space to explore and fail
A collaborative, inclusive team culture with international cooperation
Continuous learning through our advanced learning platform, with unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning and Busuu language learning
All the tools you need to succeed: laptop, iPhone, and a fully equipped home office
Excellent work life balance, including 42 vacation days, flexible working hours, and hybrid working options
A strong pension plan and collective health insurance options
An environment built on trust and respect, with room to explore, learn, and even fail
To get a career instead of a job. We have many opportunities for internal growth; and we encourage it!

📩 How To Apply

We’re excited to learn how you can contribute to our mission of smarter, safer food inspection. Apply now and join a team transforming the future of food processing.

📧 Questions? Contact: Maarten Krepel – maarten.krepel@jbtmarel.com

🌐 Learn more at: jbtmarel.com

🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn

Connect with Talent Acquisition Specialist: www.linkedin.com/in/maartenkrepel

JBT Marel is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

Join us — and be the driving force behind smarter, leaner food production.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer
Location:
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Job Type:
Full-time
Seniority Level:
Senior
Experience:
3–5 years
Salary:
SAR 12,000 – 18,000 / month
Job Objective
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team to design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable software solutions. In this role, you will develop core applications, optimize performance, resolve complex technical issues, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable digital products.
Key Responsibilities
Design & Development:
Build scalable, high-performance software applications aligned with business requirements using clean, maintainable code.
Testing & Quality Assurance:
Test applications, diagnose technical issues, debug software, and participate in peer code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
Architecture & Integration:
Develop, integrate, and manage resilient RESTful APIs and backend services.
Performance & Optimization:
Identify system bottlenecks to continuously improve application speed, security, and stability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Work closely with Product, UI/UX Design, QA, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Documentation & Best Practices:
Maintain technical documentation for system architecture and keep pace with modern technologies and industry best practices.

Qualifications & Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience:
3–5 years of professional software development experience.
Core Engineering Skills:

Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
Strong working knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
Experience with API design, integration, and development.
Hands-on experience with version control systems (Git, GitHub/GitLab).
Soft Skills:

Strong analytical and algorithmic problem-solving abilities.
Solid organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Benefits & Perks
Competitive Compensation:
SAR 12,000 – 18,000 per month.
Career Growth:
Ample opportunities for skill advancement, continuous learning, and professional development.
Diverse Projects:
Work on varied high-impact projects within a professional, collaborative environment.
